summary: Phase 3 FINALE validation of /home-experience-v3 (Actes I → VIII). All 8 acts working end-to-end. Actes V-VIII (Univers services, Personnalisation, Conversion, Rassurance) lazy-load correctly after currentScene>=3. Personalization mapping validated for 3 intents (self_discovery, relationship, no-intent fallback). ActThread golden-line SVG present; feather floating animation active with correct keyframe name. Signup CTA propagates intent+welcome+source. 22/23 checks pass. One minor finding on scrollY after ScrollToTop navigation to /inscription (185px instead of 0px, likely due to layout shift after route change).

integration_issues.issue: After clicking home-experience-signup-cta from Act 7, window.scrollY reads 185px (not 0px) at ~1.3s post-navigation. Root cause: /inscription page mounts lazy sections/cookie banner AFTER the useLayoutEffect scroll-to-top has already run, so subsequent DOM mutations shift the viewport. Not a broken user-flow (header + form are visible), but strict spec expected scrollY===0. Consider adding a second requestAnimationFrame scroll in ScrollToTop, or reading `location.state.scrollTop=0` pattern.

action_items: MINOR: Investigate why window.scrollY=185 after navigating from Act7 to /inscription. Likely a race between useLayoutEffect and lazy content mount. Suggestion in ScrollToTop.jsx: schedule an extra scrollTo(0,0) via requestAnimationFrame or on 'load' event after route change.
critical_code_review_comments: Act6Personalization.jsx: relies on both useExperienceStore.intent AND sessionStorage.exp_intent via readIntent(). Good fallback chain, but note that a full page reload on Act 6 (direct URL) will only find intent in sessionStorage — works as expected. No hardcoded routes leak.
Act7Conversion.jsx buildSignupUrl: correctly encodes intent/exp_card/utm/welcome/source. Verified href = /inscription?intent=self_discovery&welcome=1&source=home_v3.

HomeExperienceRoot.jsx: lazy-loading Actes V-VIII triggers ONLY when currentScene>=3. Direct jump to act-5 via ActNav requires user to first cross act-3 (my test flow simulates this by clicking act-3 then act-5). Consider triggering setLoadRest(true) synchronously when ActNav jumps to an act >=5 as well, to avoid the 2-click workaround. Not a bug — just UX polish.

ExperienceFallback (reduced-motion path) diverges heavily from the 8-act WebGL structure (no exp-s1__brand h1, no scene-4 particles, only a single hero + CTA). This is expected but means the 8-act taxonomy is only advertised on the full-motion path. ActNav is still rendered with 8 dots which may confuse reduced-motion users. Suggestion: reduce ActNav to actsAvailable=1 or hide it when fallback is active.

ActThread.jsx: getTotalLength() computed once on mount from a viewBox 0..100 path — after resize, the dash length can be off. Consider a ResizeObserver, or use pathLength='1' attribute + integer offset.

rca of the issue: scrollY=185 post-navigation to /inscription: useLayoutEffect in ScrollToTop fires synchronously after pathname change; however /inscription mounts CookieBanner + form + WelcomeSplash overlay after the layout effect completes, and their combined layout shifts and possible focus() calls end up scrolling the window down by ~185px. Fix: chain a rAF-based additional scrollTo(0,0) in ScrollToTop, or listen to a 'route-mounted' signal from routes that have known heavy async mounting.
